construct: RULED, THE K2 CELL (refreshed 2026-09-21): k2_overview 40–70w (the persona's current in the element's arena) + k2_functional ≤22w (the god's own family function, re-ruled 2026-09-01) + k2_domain_readings 18–55w per ruled domain (owner construct 2026-08-19, corpus ×50 LOCKED) · adj_chips {catalyst ×3, friction ×3} 1–3w under THE KEYWORD DERIVATION CHAIN (2026-09-03) and THE VOCABULARY ZONE B1–B2 (2026-09-04) · fn_reading = the weighted three-door ledger {word, doors:{trait, scene, outside}} ×3 per pole, 35–55w per door (THE THREE DOORS 2026-09-03; corpus ×50 complete 2026-09-04) · structural_interaction = the REA_03 §4b authoring seed · k2_card = the unauthored register stub (REA_03 §4, superseded by the cell above). Prompts: REA_17 §3.4. · edge (catalyst pole only; owner 2026-10-16, THE EDGE v9: two sentences, the energy and its three ruling domains from the GOD table, then a clause per domain in The Pattern's voice; the metric; the head derived in the app)

candidates.structural_interaction: Depth meeting depth cross-polarity — intelligence competing with intelligence
candidates.k2_overview: Your Water moves as the Rival: current that races current. You compete the way tides do, quietly, continuously, gaining by inches that look like accidents. Shared flows suit you: pooled funds, joint journeys, split winnings. Just remember that merged water is hard to unmix. Mark what is yours before the confluence.
candidates.k2_functional: Your energy ebbs and floods: read your own tide chart and schedule accordingly.

k2_domain_readings.Rivalry: Your rivalries run underwater: unspoken races, silent measurements, positions gained without visible waves. Surface one or two. A named, laughing rivalry refreshes you more than ten secret ones.
k2_domain_readings.Shared stakes: Money and effort pool around you like watersheds: group funds, family flows, blended accounts. You track it all mentally and forgive it all eventually. Put banks around what must not flood away.
k2_domain_readings.Boldness: Your daring is fluid: risks taken by drift and momentum more than announcement. It carries you far. Just check occasionally that the current you are riding is one you chose.

catalyst.define: Running thin, the well is shallow. Other people's energy fills it faster than rest does.

angles.drive: A race gets all of you moving. You come alive with a rival in sight, and chasing a real person drives you harder than any plan. Your best work shows up with someone fast at your shoulder.
angles.cost_self: You feel most alive inside a race. You dread standing still, and you race more than you rest and spend what the quiet weeks put back. The tiredness from one contest is still in you at the start of the next.
angles.cost_others: Every race you love needs someone else in it. You make a rival of a peer without asking first, and the race starts on your word. Time with you comes with a scoreboard running.

angles.drive: Jumping in first is how you learn what a thing is like. You want to feel things for yourself, and being inside a decision suits you better than planning beside it. You bring back first-hand news while everyone else is still reading about it.
angles.cost_self: Going first is where your boldness lives. Coming second feels like losing, and you jump in with your own savings on the line before reading the small print. Your bank balance carries the lessons everyone after you gets for free.
angles.cost_others: Whenever you go first, you pull the one closest to you in after you. You decide for both before asking, and you take the risk in their name too. The person beside you gets courage on loan the moment you move.

angles.drive: Going all in together is the only way you go in. Shared stakes feel more real to you than a safe share kept back, so you pool money and effort. You want to win with people, never just near them.
angles.cost_self: Inside a shared stake, you feel your bravest. A pooled stake feels like company, and all in feels better to you than holding some back. A bad turn takes your whole share at once, with nothing set aside to land on.
angles.cost_others: All in together means you take someone with you every time. You put up the shared stake before asking whose it was, and a partner carries losses they never signed for. Anyone in with you lives through each venture's lows as well as its highs.

friction.define: Running over, the depth churns and floods into every contest. You need to prove yourself among friends, and the drive never lets you stop.

angles.drive: Racing in secret keeps the race one you cannot lose. You fear losing in the open, and you measure a friend quietly rather than name the race. Remember that you race a friend because you want to count as their equal.
angles.cost_self: Secret racing keeps you safe while you race. Being seen to try and fail scares you most, and you spend your drive on quiet races rather than on one open try. You never get the win said out loud.
angles.cost_others: In secret, you make a friend a rival without asking them. You keep the race hidden rather than risk losing it in the open. You take away their chance to answer, or to race you face to face.

angles.drive: Spending shared money comes easier to you than spending your own. Nobody's name is on it, and you dip into it before asking who put what in. You run the pool down faster than anyone agreed to.
angles.cost_self: Spending from the shared pot is the easiest money there is. Wanting a good night for everyone, you let the pot pay for it before your own savings do. You end up owing the group more than you noticed spending.
angles.cost_others: Each time you spend what was pooled, you spend someone else's decision. You move the money rather than ask, and you leave the others a smaller share than they put in. You want everyone looked after, and some of that comes out of their share.

angles.drive: Never enough is the rule under everything you win. You fear falling behind the moment you stop, and you want the next prize more than the one in hand. You never named a finish line, so you never get to cross one.
angles.cost_self: Never having enough keeps you bold after the boldness has paid. Slowing down scares you more than running short, and you spend the win on the next race rather than bank it. You end each year with more wins than savings.
angles.cost_others: Whenever enough is not enough, you keep your partners running past their finish. You push for the next round before asking, and they put in more than they meant. You use up the break they had planned to take at the end.

edge.lead: Water runs through your wealth, your social life and your career. It is the money you chase harder once someone else wants it, the dare your friends already know you will take, and the new way through you find when the old one closes.
